camel_example: aliyun push PushNoticeToiOS --region cn-hangzhou --Target ALL --TargetValue ALL --AppKey 24780725 --Body Hello_World --ApnsEnv DEV
description_en: Send a notification to iOS devices. The notification uses Apple’s APNs channel and appears directly in the device notification center
description_zh: 推送通知到 iOS 设备端，通知通过苹果APNs通道下发，并直接在设备通知栏弹出
kebab_example: aliyun push push-notice-to-ios --app-key 24780725 --target ALL --target-value ALL --apns-env DEV --biz-body Hello_World --region cn-hangzhou
name: PushNoticeToiOS

parameters.help_en:
The target of the push. Valid values:

DEVICE: Push to specific devices.

ACCOUNT: Push to specific accounts.

ALIAS: Push to users with specific aliases.

TAG: Push to users with specific tags.

ALL: Push to all devices
parameters.help_zh:
推送目标。可取值：

DEVICE：根据设备推送
ACCOUNT：根据账号推送
ALIAS：根据别名推送
TAG：根据标签推送
ALL：推送给全部设备
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
Values depend on the Target value. Separate multiple values with commas. If you exceed the limit, send multiple requests.

If Target=DEVICE, use values such as `deviceid111,deviceid1111`. Maximum: 1000.

If Target=ACCOUNT, use values such as `account111,account222`. Maximum: 1000.

If Target=ALIAS, use values such as `alias111,alias222`. Maximum: 1000.

If Target=TAG, support single or multiple tags. For format details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434847.html.

If Target=ALL, set this to ALL
parameters.help_zh:
根据Target来设定，多个值使用逗号分隔，超过限制需要分多次推送。

Target=DEVICE，值如`deviceid111,deviceid1111`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ACCOUNT，值如`account111,account222`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ALIAS，值如`alias111,alias222`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=TAG，支持单Tag和多Tag，格式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434847.html。
Target=ALL，值为ALL
parameters.name: target_value

parameters.help_en:
iOS notifications use Apple’s APNs service. Specify the environment.

DEV: Development environment.

PRODUCT: Production environment
parameters.help_zh:
iOS的通知是通过APNS中心来发送的，需要填写对应的环境信息。
DEV：表示开发环境
PRODUCT：表示生产环境
parameters.name: apns_env

parameters.help_en:
The title of the notification.

iOS 10 and later: Displays as the notification title.

iOS 8.2 through iOS 9.x: Replaces the app name in the notification
parameters.help_zh:
推送的通知的标题。
iOS 10+通知显示标题。
iOS 8.2 <= iOS系统 < iOS 10：替换通知应用名称
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The body text of the notification
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: A custom ID for the push task. If you specify a JobKey, the delivery log includes this field. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html
parameters.help_zh: 推送任务自定义标识，当JobKey不为空时，回执日志中会附带该字段。查看回执日志参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html
parameters.name: job_key

parameters.help_en:
A custom key-value map for developer extensions.

For iOS devices, pass this parameter as a JSON object. Otherwise, parsing fails
parameters.help_zh:
自定义的KV结构，开发者扩展用。

针对iOS设备，该参数要以JSON map的格式传入，否则会解析出错
parameters.name: ext_parameters

MessageId.description_en: The message ID for this push request
